otherTracksConsidered.why: In season (22 Feb 2015) and names Triple Couloirs, but the Peakbagger entry has no GPS track points, so there is nothing to assign; used for facts only.

facts.text: Late February: the rock step below the first couloir is a single rope length; the left-hand line is easier, the right side is steep and poorly protected.
Late February: ice steps linking the three couloirs bottleneck when several parties start together.
In late February the runnel steps took ice screws well; the shortest screws (10-13 cm) were the most useful, and pitons took easily at belays.
Pickets give solid protection on the long snow ramps between steps where rock gear is scarce; simul-climb the easy sections, since pitching everything is slow.
insulated bottle holder or water kept inside the jacket (water froze solid in late February)
In late February the descent from the summit is a plunge-step down the backside in snow, reaching Colchuck Lake after dark if the climb ran long.
